extracted.intended_audience: trademark/patent examiners, IP attorneys, classification specialists
extracted.subtask_description: A taxonomy listing goods and subcategories (household receptacles; tools and hardware; fittings) used for classifying products in IP/trademark contexts. The page enumerates named product types under numbered sections and class/subclass headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household receptacles / table and kitchen receptacles
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates household/table receptacles and related utensils: pose-plats, porte-menus, moutardiers, porte-serviettes (pour la table), ronds de serviettes, casse-noix, huiliers-vinaigriers, bottles (ouvre-), poivriers, sandwich (pique-), dessous de plats, chauffe-plats, couverts (porte-), salieres, pique-sandwichs, biere (ecumoires a-), fixe-serviettes, bottles (supports de-), ustensiles de table, pailles pour boissons, chalumeaux, sucriers de table, fouets a champagne, napperons (pinces pour-), cosys, pinces a glace, oeufs (decalotteurs), truelles (ustensiles de table), isothermic boxes (except packaging), ashpans, laundry baskets, wastepaper bins, bread bins, buckets (household), canvas water carriers, chamber pots, coal scuttles, food storage containers, spice boxes, tubs, wash-hang basins, water carriers (canvas), cendriers (seau a cendres), boites a pain, glacières d'appartement (portatives), corbeilles a linge, recipients a dechets, pails/ seaux, vases de nuit, entreposage en refrigerateur, and other named household storage and receptacle items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fireplace implements
rubrics_metrics.description: Items for fireplace use: andirons (chenets), bellows (foyers soufflets), fire irons, tongs (tongs (fire -)), pokers (tisonniers / pique-feu), fireplace screens (ecrans de cheminee d'appartement), pincettes pour foyers (pincettes pour-), and household fireguards (garde-feu de cheminee d'appartement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous household items (Class 07 - Misc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: A misc. grouping including balls of wool and winding appliances, bed warmers (non-electric), boot jacks, hot-water bottles, brush holders, buttonhooks, (electric or other) can openers, apparatus for drawing and filling bottles (hand-operated), foot warmers, funnels (utensils), gas igniters, holders for rolls of kitchen paper, lavatory-brush holders, tin/can openers, bottle-filling devices, heating devices for beds (non-electric), plant watering devices, shoe trees, shoehorns, tube squeezers (paste-tube), stands/holders for tubes, trays (household), and many other named small household implements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 08 — Tools and hardware (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level heading for tools and hardware; the class contains many numbered subdivisions covering tools for drilling/digging, hammers, cutting tools, screwdrivers, other tools and implements, handles/knobs/hinges, locking/closing devices, fastening/supporting/mounting devices not included elsewhere, metal fittings and mountings for doors/windows/furniture, and miscellaneous metal articles (e.g., chains, racks, wires).

rubrics_metrics.name: 01) Tools and implements for drilling, milling or digging
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes augers, awls, bits (tools), borers, boring heads (counterbore-), bows (drill-), braces (tools), countersink reamers, dibbles, tools for digging/draining (draining-spades), drill bows, combined drills (with countersink), hand drills, hoes, ice axes, mining drills (jumpers), mattocks, milling cutters (except dental), hand-operated milling machines/tools, pickaxes, picks/quarry picks, reamers, shovels (snow shovels), spades, trowels (garden), small drills (tools), tarieres (French for augers), meches (drill bits), and other named tools serving to dig, bore, drill or mill.

rubrics_metrics.name: 02) Hammers and similar tools and implements
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes various hammers/mallets and related impact tools: mallets, panel-beating hammers, pneumatic hammers, rammers (earth rammers, hand tools), riveting hammers, stonebreakers, and other listed hammer types and related non-electric/pneumatic tools for shaping or breaking materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: 03) Cutting tools and implements
rubrics_metrics.description: Broad list of cutting tools: adzes, axes, billhooks, plane blades, boning/knives for meat, burins (engravers'), butchers' mincers, chisels (coachbuilders', mortise-, for grooving, stonework), cleavers, clippers (hedge -), dado cutters, glass cutters, grafting knives, gravers, gouges, hacksaws, hatchets, hay choppers, kitchen knives (including electric), lawn trimmers, machetes, mincers, nippers, penknives, pipe cutters, planes, pocket knives, pruners, pruning hooks, reapers, saw blades and saws (hand, mechanical, chain saws), scissors, scrapers, scythes, secateurs, shears (pruning-), sickles, sod cutters, and many other named cutting and trimming tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: 04) Screwdrivers and other similar tools and implements
rubrics_metrics.description: Screwdrivers (tournevis) and similar turning tools are listed under this subsection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 05) Other tools and implements
rubrics_metrics.description: A large, catch-all subsection listing numerous tools and hand implements: abrasive sheet holders, adjusting (grinding) wheels, agricultural atomizers (hand-operated), anvils, blowlamps, boat hooks, boilers (tools for scaling), box (miter) boxes, bread molds, bricklayers' hoes/trowels, butchers' slaughtering apparatus, caulking implements, carpenters' clamps, cork polishing appliances, crimping tools, crowbars, cutting screw-thread tools, decorating bags for confectioners, defrosting tools, dies (threading), discs for sanding machines, electricians' pliers, extractors (nail/pin), files (abrasive), feed/gun grease pumps (hand-operated), grinding wheels, hones, irons (soldering, electric or non-electric), joiners' cramps, knife sharpeners, ladles (casting), lasts for shoemaking, levers, nail extractors, oilstones, paint rollers/spray guns, punch/drifts, rasps, razors (sharpeners), soldering blow torches, spanners, spokeshaves, stapling/fixing tools (except office), taps/wrenches, threading dies, tyre levers, vices and vice jaws, watering cans, wedges, welding torches, whetstones, wire-stretchers, wrecking bars, pipe wrenches, and many other named workshop/household/professional tools and accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 06) Handles, knobs and hinges
rubrics_metrics.description: Hardware items for carrying, opening and furniture fittings: bell pulls, push-buttons, carry-cot handles, coffin handles, curtain pulls, door handles, handles for vehicles, cork knobs, drawer handles, furniture handles, sash/window handles, hinge pins for doors, strap hinges for doors/windows, knobs for drawers/doors, pulls (bell), curtain tirrets, push buttons, sash window handles, rings for drawers, knobs for furniture, handles for briefcases/handbags/mallets, and associated named fittings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 07) Locking or closing devices (locks, bolts, catches etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Security and closing hardware: bicycle safety locks, window/venetian blind catches, flat bolts, box fastenings, brakes, cable-type padlocks for cycles, casement bolts for windows/doors, door checks, window latches, catches for shutters, cigarette-case clasps, clasps for other cases, keeps (of locks), keys (including for electric contacts), tumblers, padlocks, manacles, openers (electric or other), sash/window locks, theftproof locks, targettes (striker plates), latches, lock bolts, locking devices for vehicles (door locks), mortice/ tumbler/anti-theft varieties, and many related lock hardware items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 081) Fastening, supporting or mounting devices not included in other classes
rubrics_metrics.description: Various fasteners, supports and mounting hardware: angle irons (bed angle irons), belleville washers, belts (fasteners for machine belts), fittings for blinds and curtains, bolts, brackets (for electric razors, for holding cleaning brushes, for radio sets for vehicles, for showers), brads, brush holders (brackets for holding cleaning brushes), cable clamps/cleats (non-electric), cable fastening clips, ceiling light fixing devices, chain swivels, clamps (for hoses and pipes), clips (fastening for cables), coat pegs, collars for electric conductors and pipes, cotter pins (engineering), curtain hooks/rings, bed brackets (equerres d'eclisses), gas-fitting bands (colliers pour conduites a gaz), machine-belt attachments, curtain rail/triple supports, bolts/nuts/washers, suspension stirrups for pipes, supports for radiators/central heating, and many other named fastening/supporting fittings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09) Metal fittings and mountings for doors, windows, furniture and similar articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Fittings for doors/windows/furniture and similar articles: coffin fittings, door stops, finger plates for doors, trunk fittings, lock fittings and rosettes for locks, window stops, and other metal mountings for these categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 99) Miscellaneous (Class 08 miscellany)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catch-all miscellaneous metal products and hardware: barbed wire, bicycle racks, Bowden cables, buffer stops for beds/trolleys/doors, chain links, curtain rails, drums for electric cable, hosepipe reels, magnets, metal cables/wires/chains, racks, rails (curtain-), rods (welding), sawhorses, scrap/stone scrapers, tension links, trellises, tressles for building industry, weathercocks, welding rods, and numerous other metal articles and fittings (including many entries translated into French in the list).
